recipe.visualDefinition: A high-glamour studio portrait featuring a central female figure with voluminous textured hair, seated on reflective crinkled plastic, set against a deep blue-to-magenta gradient background with bold, geometric graphic overlays.
coreVisualRelationships: The warm red of the dress and shoes contrasts sharply with the cool blue-violet background.
The jagged, hand-drawn graphic strokes in the upper right echo the sharp highlights on the cellophane floor.
The horizontal rule lines in the typography stabilize the organic, voluminous shape of the subject's hair.
The high-key lighting on the subject's skin creates a metallic sheen that matches the reflective floor texture.
coreInvariants: Crinkled transparent plastic or cellophane floor surface

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centrally located, seated in a diagonal pose that spans from the bottom left to the center right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and dramatic hair serve as the primary focal point, anchored by the bright red dress.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the subject's face, down the diagonal line of the legs, then up to the graphic logo in the top right corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space in the upper left and right corners allows for typographic elements and emphasizes the subject's silhouette.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep indigo and violet gradients provide the atmospheric background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vivid tomato red is used for the clothing and graphic elements to pop against the cool backdrop.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright white is used for jewelry, highlights on the plastic, and primary text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the reds and blues with high-contrast highlights on reflective surfaces.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to primary red, deep blue, and white

characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'A' lacks a crossbar in some 80s variations, though here it is standard geometric.
Letters are bisected or framed by thin horizontal white lines.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used with varying tracking and horizontal line dividers.

candidateDirections.reason: Classic geometric foundation with sharp points.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a woman with large 80s textured hair, wearing a red silk dress, sitting on a floor covered in crinkled transparent cellophane. The background is a smooth gradient of dark blue to magenta. High-contrast lighting with sharp highlights on the plastic.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a geometric sans-serif title in the top right corner in white. Use extreme letter spacing. Place three jagged, diagonal red brush strokes behind the text. Insert thin white horizontal lines between the rows of text.

verificationChecks: Is the hair silhouette sufficiently large and textured?
Is the floor texture clearly identifiable as crinkled plastic?
Does the red color pop against the blue background?
Is the text tracking wide enough to feel 'editorial'?

adjustableVariables: Amount of crinkle in the plastic floor
Thickness of the horizontal rule lines
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no text is garbled or hallucinated in the background.
Check that the red dress doesn't bleed into the blue background.
Verify the plastic floor looks reflective rather than liquid.
Confirm the hair texture is sharp and not blurry.
recipe.reuseFormula: Geometric Sans + Wide Tracking + Horizontal Rules + Red/Blue Gradient + Reflective Texture.
